summary:
**Root cause:** `.env.example` set `VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5199` — that's the Vite dev-server port used in the screenshot instructions, not the backend's. With that value every `/api/v1/...` call is aimed at the SPA itself rather than the API, so the Integrations tab's `GET /api/v1/settings/integrations` never reaches a server and the raw `TypeError: Failed to fetch` was rendered straight into the tab's error box.

**Changes (both in this repo):**
- `.env.example` — point the base URL at the backend (`http://localhost:8000`, the origin the backend's own CORS config expects a dev frontend to call), with a comment warning against the dev-server port.
- `src/services/http.js` — wrap the `fetch` call so a transport-level failure (API down, wrong base URL, CORS, offline) is converted into the standard `HttpError` shape instead of a bare `TypeError`. The Integrations tab (and every other screen's error state) now shows "Unable to reach the server at … Check that the API is running and try again." with its working Retry button, rather than "Failed to fetch".

Reading taken: the smaller one — fix the misconfigured API base URL causing the failed fetch and make the resulting error legible, without touching the Integrations feature code itself. Lint, tests (150) and build all pass. Note `.env.local` is gitignored and not in my allowed path set, so if your local copy has the old `5199` value you'll need to update it there too.
blockers: Not applied -- Updating the developer's local .env.local to the corrected base URL: the file is gitignored and outside the allowed path set — it must be changed by hand locally

Visual verification failed: The /settings/admin route (and even the app root) renders a completely blank white page at 1440x900 — no Admin tabs, no Integrations card, and no error state with a retry are visible, so the 'Failed to fetch' fix cannot be confirmed. The repo has no .env.local, so the required VITE_API_BASE_URL is unset and the client's startup throw blanks the SPA; the .env.example change alone does not reach the running dev server.

endpoints.purpose: Exchange the httpOnly refresh cookie for a new access token

context_sharing.notes: The shared client sends `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` plus `credentials: 'include'` on every request; it no longer sends X-User-Role/X-User-Id. A 401 on any non-/auth/ path triggers one POST /auth/refresh retry, so the refresh endpoint must set/rotate the httpOnly refresh cookie and return `accessToken`. Base URL comes from VITE_API_BASE_URL (e.g. http://localhost:8000) and is prefixed to every path; all non-2xx bodies must be `{ error, details }`. Binary downloads are fetched with the same auth header and the filename is read from Content-Disposition.
